metadata.name: Architecture Design Flow
metadata.description: Produces a decision-ready, maintained architecture package for either a new system or an existing product. It resolves source and delivery authority, materializes a durable workspace, performs scenario-appropriate requirements discovery or evidence-backed reverse engineering, develops proportionate architecture decisions and documentation without forcing C4, DDD, arc42, Mermaid or arbitrary counts, validates only mechanically observable package properties, and requires independent whole-package review. Cause-owned repair and independently reviewed contract correction return to the earliest stale responsibility; autonomous mode skips only final user acceptance. Outcomes distinguish complete, reviewed-limited, blocked, workspace failure and interactive abort, while project delivery occurs only to an explicitly authorized target. The workflow never changes product code, commits, publishes, notifies, releases or deploys.

nodes.directive: Resolve one bounded architecture decision/use, new or existing scenario, authorized source, output scope, constraints, operating mode and success criteria from the request and discoverable context. Ask only for a material unknown. Do not invent source access, requirements, current-state evidence, delivery authority or compliance claims. Return ready or blocked.
nodes.completionCondition: The architecture boundary, scenario, source and delivery authority are actionable or the missing prerequisite is explicit

nodes.directive: Work only in {{workspace_path}}. As sole writer of architecture-contract.md, record the originating goal {{architecture_goal}}, decision use {{decision_use}}, scenario {{scenario_type}}, scope and constraints {{architecture_scope}}, authorized source {{#if source_path}}{{source_path}}{{else}}not supplied for the new-system scenario{{/if}}, and delivery authority {{delivery_scope}} with target {{#if delivery_target}}{{delivery_target}}{{else}}the execution workspace{{/if}} without incorporating later corrections. Initialize repair-account.md with a factual header, not workflow state. Return ready or blocked.
nodes.completionCondition: The immutable architecture contract and repair-account header exist or their irreducible absence is recorded

nodes.directive: Work only in {{workspace_path}}. Read architecture-contract.md, accepted corrected-contract.md, architecture-principles.md and current revision_request {{revision_request}}. Write discovery.md with supplied requirements, stakeholders, constraints, decision questions, responsibilities, external interactions, unknowns and evidence labels. Use C4, DDD, arc42 or another method only where it improves the actual decision. Do not invent facts or satisfy counts. Set discovery_status ready or limited; return replan or blocked when the contract or required evidence cannot support honest work.
nodes.completionCondition: The new-system discovery is decision-ready with explicit limitations, or its upstream or blocked cause is explicit

nodes.directive: Work only in {{workspace_path}}. Read architecture-contract.md, accepted corrected-contract.md, architecture-principles.md and current revision_request {{revision_request}}. Inspect the exact authorized source {{source_path}}; write source-evidence.md and current-state.md with code/config/dependency/deployment/test/document evidence, representative behavior traces, observed boundaries, current quality, gaps, risks, debt, inferences and unknowns kept distinct. Do not impose file-depth, trace-count or gap quotas. Set discovery_status ready or limited; return replan or blocked when the contract or required source cannot support honest work.
nodes.completionCondition: The existing-system current state is evidence-backed and decision-ready with explicit limitations, or its upstream or blocked cause is explicit

nodes.directive: Work only in {{workspace_path}}. Read the effective architecture contract, architecture-principles.md, the applicable discovery artifacts and current revision_request {{revision_request}}. Write architecture.md and decisions.md as one coherent decision set: appropriate boundaries and decomposition, interfaces and data flow, failure behavior, significant decisions with genuine alternatives and consequences, measurable quality scenarios, crosscutting and operational concerns, risks, and for existing systems evidence-linked incremental improvements. Keep as-is, inference and target state distinct. Do not force C4, DDD, arc42, Mermaid or fixed counts when another representation fits better. Return ready, replan or blocked.
nodes.completionCondition: The architecture decision set is coherent, evidence-linked and proportionate, or its upstream or blocked cause is explicit

nodes.directive: Work only in {{workspace_path}}. Read the effective contract, discovery artifacts, architecture.md, decisions.md, architecture-principles.md and current revision_request {{revision_request}}. Build one coherent maintained package under package/ with INDEX navigation and every artifact needed for the requested architecture decision: applicable overview, context and decomposition views, interfaces and data ownership, decisions, quality scenarios, crosscutting and operational concerns, risks or improvement roadmap, and glossary where useful. Record justified omissions and evidence limits in limitations.md. Do not create irrelevant files or fixed-count padding. Return ready, replan or blocked.
nodes.completionCondition: The applicable architecture package and limitations are coherent and navigable, or their upstream or blocked cause is explicit

nodes.directive: Work only in {{workspace_path}}. Perform a fresh producer-completion pass over the exact effective contract, discovery evidence and its current status {{discovery_status}}, architecture decisions, package and limitations. When entered from a completion-owned finding, read package-validation.md and semantic-review.md, reproduce every current completion-local blocker, and append one factual entry to repair-account.md before rewriting the owned completion state. Close foreseeable omissions before gates. Atomically write completion.md and return matching result_status, architecture_summary and limitation_summary; complete is valid only when the requested decision is fully supported, otherwise limited is valid only for a useful package whose non-critical limitations are explicit. Return ready, replan or blocked.
nodes.completionCondition: The exact package is producer-complete with a truthful complete or limited class, or its upstream or blocked cause is explicit

nodes.directive: Work only in {{workspace_path}}. Read the exact effective contract, package/, limitations.md and completion.md. Overwrite package-validation.md with deterministic observations only: required artifact presence under the contract, parseability, internal link resolution, and diagram rendering only when an applicable supported renderer exists. Name the required and plausible wrong states for every check. Do not infer architecture fitness or build proof machinery. Return pass, one earliest repair owner, replan for an invalid evidence model, or blocked.
nodes.completionCondition: The exact package has one truthful deterministic report and an outcome whose evidence modality matches the property

nodes.directive: Work only in {{workspace_path}}. Delegate one genuinely independent whole-package reviewer using an available independent-agent mechanism; if none exists, return blocked. The reviewer reads the exact effective contract, authorized primary evidence, architecture.md, decisions.md, package/, limitations.md, completion.md and package-validation.md. Overwrite semantic-review.md with the complete current blocking set or zero findings. Judge architecture fitness, boundaries, tradeoffs, provenance, consistency, quality attributes, maintainability, limitations and authority. Diagnose but never repair. Return pass, one earliest repair owner, replan for an upstream or unprovable criterion, or blocked.
nodes.completionCondition: One independent exact-package review records all current blockers and returns an outcome owned by their earliest cause

nodes.directive: Work only in {{workspace_path}}. Read exactly package-validation.md, reproduce every owner-local blocker, repair the complete confirmed class in package/ and limitations.md, and append one factual entry to repair-account.md with classification, manifestations, bounded scope, owning artifact, changed knowledge and stale downstream stages. Return changed only after the artifact changed; return reassess for an invalid or non-local cause and blocked for an irreducible failure.
nodes.completionCondition: The confirmed repair class changed with a durable repair account, or its non-local or blocked cause is explicit

nodes.directive: Work only in {{workspace_path}}. Reassess current revision_request {{revision_request}} against immutable architecture-contract.md, repair-account.md and every previously accepted correction. Never rewrite the originating goal or authority. Overwrite corrected-contract.md with one cumulative bounded supplement that corrects only the invalid derived criterion, method or responsibility and names the earliest reentry_owner discovery|architecture|package|validation|completion. Return corrected or blocked.
nodes.completionCondition: The cumulative correction preserves originating authority and names the earliest stale responsibility, or the invalid contract is blocked

nodes.directive: Work only in {{workspace_path}}. Delegate independent review of corrected-contract.md against immutable architecture-contract.md, repair-account.md and every previously accepted correction. Overwrite corrected-contract-findings.md with the complete current blockers or zero findings. Pass only when the correction preserves goal, scope and authority and reentry_owner is the earliest stale normal responsibility; replan repeats reassessment with changed relevant knowledge; blocked ends truthfully.
nodes.completionCondition: The exact cumulative correction independently passes or its replan or blocked cause is explicit

nodes.directive: Present the independently accepted local architecture package at {{package_path}}, architecture summary {{architecture_summary}} and limitations {{limitation_summary}}. Ask to accept, abort, or request one concrete rework owner discovery|architecture|package|validation|completion|contract with a non-blank revision_request. Do not infer new authority.
nodes.completionCondition: The user accepted, aborted or supplied one actionable owner-scoped rework request

nodes.directive: Copy the exact independently accepted package/ bytes from {{workspace_path}} to the already authorized destination {{delivery_target}}. Do not broaden the destination or mutate product code. Overwrite delivery-evidence.md with the source and destination observations and verify direct file identity, which distinguishes the accepted revision from an older or partial copy. Return delivered, replan for an invalid delivery criterion/contract, or blocked for an irreducible authorized delivery failure.
nodes.completionCondition: The authorized destination contains the exact accepted package or the upstream or blocked cause is explicit

nodes.directive: Work only in {{workspace_path}}. Write final-report.md with useful completed architecture work, blocker {{terminal_reason}} and recovery action; return delivery_status=workspace and do not claim accepted project delivery.
nodes.completionCondition: The blocked result is truthful and recoverable

nodes.directive: Work only in {{workspace_path}}. Write final-report.md with the user's abort and useful completed architecture work; return delivery_status=workspace.
nodes.completionCondition: The abort is recorded without acceptance

nodes.directive: Report the observed architecture-workspace materialization failure as terminal_reason and include a concrete recovery action.
nodes.completionCondition: Workspace failure is explicit

nodes.directive: Report the pre-workspace architecture intake blocker {{terminal_reason}} and recovery action without claiming a local artifact path.
nodes.completionCondition: The intake blocker is truthful and no workspace artifact is claimed

nodes.hint: Use only when the architecture method, interpretation or criterion itself is invalid, not for an ordinary failed check or review finding.
nodes.directive: Return one active revision_request that corrects the remaining architecture process while preserving the originating goal, source and authority and naming still-valid completed work. Do not use this teleport to bypass an ordinary failed check or review finding.
nodes.completionCondition: The bounded process correction preserves originating authority and can enter independent corrected-contract review

operating_mode.description: Whether final user acceptance is enabled for this execution.

architecture_principles.description: Universal outcome-oriented architecture criteria materialized once for every role.
architecture_principles.default:
# Architecture principles

Apply only criteria relevant to the actual system and decision; inapplicable criteria require no substitute artifact. Preserve explicit responsibilities and dependencies, evidence provenance, honest alternatives and consequences, failure behavior, data ownership and flow, measurable quality where measurement is meaningful, maintainability and operational fit. Separate observed current state, inference, requirement and target state. Use C4, DDD, arc42, Mermaid or another notation only when it helps the actual decision. Do not invent fixed counts, diagrams, boundaries, gaps, ADRs or concerns. A deterministic check proves only the property its observation distinguishes; semantic architecture fitness requires direct independent judgment against requirements and primary evidence.

scenario_type.description: Whether the workflow designs a new system or analyzes an existing one.

decision_use.description: Decision or maintenance use the architecture package must support.

architecture_scope.description: Requested architecture scope, constraints, stakeholders and success criteria.

source_path.description: Exact authorized source path for an existing-system analysis.

delivery_scope.description: Whether accepted output remains in the workspace or is copied to an authorized project target.

delivery_target.description: Explicit authorized project destination for accepted architecture files.

discovery_status.description: Current source and requirements evidence readiness class.

result_status.description: Producer-completion class reviewed with the exact architecture package.

architecture_summary.description: Bounded summary of the exact producer-complete architecture package.

limitation_summary.description: Bounded summary of current architecture limitations.

revision_request.description: Current bounded process correction or user rework request.

reentry_owner.description: Earliest normal responsibility made stale by a corrected contract.

terminal_reason.description: Current irreducible blocker observed by its owning responsibility.

terminal_status.description: Truthful terminal class for the architecture execution.

artifact_path.description: Safe path to the final local architecture report.

package_path.description: Stable path to the accepted local architecture package.
